title: Outdoor Augmented Reality Escape Room in Centennial Olympic Park
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb: Step into the shoes of elite agents in our outdoor escape room, where the thrill of a scavenger hunt meets innovative augmented reality. Starting at our downtown hub, you and your team will receive an Actionpack filled with locks, clues, and an iPad to guide your mission through stunning Centennial Olympic Park. As you navigate via GPS, solve intricate puzzles to thwart Spider Technologies and their mind control virus. With time ticking away, teamwork and quick thinking are your best allies.
